identity.name: Kingdom of Denmark
alt_names: Denmark with Greenland and the Faroe Islands

land.text: Denmark, as Cliopatria's last pre-occupation shape (the Danish lands, 1936-39 about 53,000 km2)

predecessors.note: 'Germany invaded Denmark on 9 April 1940, and the Danish government quickly surrendered'; 'Denmark was liberated after the end of the war in May 1945'. No Cliopatria row covers 1941-44. Cliopatria's row named Denmark-Norway runs to 1940; its 1814-1940 part is the dossier kingdom-of-denmark-1814-1940, which ends in April 1940 and names denmark as successor (slug corrected by reviewer eu-22-a).

correction.text: Denmark and the Faroe Islands with Greenland: 'After the war, Denmark resumed control of Greenland' and the colonies 'including Greenland, remained in Danish possession' since 1814

keyframe_review.note: 53,400 km2 for 1945 against the Denmark infobox 43,094 km2 (ratio 1.24: the Cliopatria outline includes coastal waters and the Faroes). The shape omits Greenland that Cliopatria adds in 1946; Greenland was cut off from Danish control in the war ('cut Greenland off from Danish control and supplies') but stayed Danish, so the 1945 keyframe takes it in from the first year.

2,273,196 km2 for 1946-2023: Denmark, the Faroe Islands and Greenland, the Danish Realm. Infobox 43,094 km2 plus Greenland 2,166,086 km2 (the Faroes' area is not on the page) is 2.21 M km2: ratio 1.03. The status of the parts changed without a frontier change: the Faroes got home rule in 1948, Greenland became an overseas county in 1953 ('converted its status from colony to overseas amt'), got home rule in 1979 and wider autonomy in 2009; all stay in the Realm. Iceland ('became an independent republic in 1944') is correctly outside.
2,273,196 km2 for 2024, unchanged. 'King Frederik X has been head of state since 14 January 2024.'

region.text: Denmark and the Faroe Islands, with Greenland ('After the war, Denmark resumed control of Greenland')

ledger.note: May 1945: Denmark is liberated and the Danish state governs again from Copenhagen. 'Germany invaded Denmark on 9 April 1940'; 'Denmark was liberated after the end of the war in May 1945' (the 4-5 May days are not on the page). The Kingdom is older; 1945 is the start of Cliopatria's row, and the Faroe Islands and Greenland are part of the realm throughout.

certainty.note: The land border with Germany (68 km) is the 1920 plebiscite line ('On 10 July 1920, Northern Schleswig was recovered by Denmark'); the coasts and the Greenland ice margin are surveyed or natural lines.

sources.title: Denmark
sources.note: Identity, Copenhagen, infobox area 43,094 km2, Greenland 2,166,086 km2, occupation 9 Apr 1940, liberation May 1945, Faroe home rule 1948, Iceland 1944, Schleswig 1920; no Greenland dates, no earlier monarchs.

sources.title: History of Greenland
sources.note: Greenland cut off in the war, 1941 US treaty, Denmark resumed control after the war, 1953 colony to overseas amt, 1979 home rule, 2009 expanded powers.

notes:
Cliopatria row: Denmark 1945..2024 (3 shapes). It shares Wikidata Q350186 with 'Danish Magnates' (1333..1351, Cliopatria's interregnum row after Christopher II): two different states in two different centuries, not one; the shared id is a Cliopatria mapping error and no merge is made. The earlier Danish states are the Cliopatria row Denmark-Norway (1526..1940), split by other groups into denmark-norway (1526..1814) and kingdom-of-denmark-1814-1940 (1814..1940); the latter is the predecessor.

One Cliopatria shape is corrected: 1945 lacks Greenland that the 1946 shape includes; with Greenland added the keyframes are continuous. The status changes of the parts (Faroe home rule 1948, Greenland a county 1953, home rule 1979, self-government 2009) are not frontier changes and the schema has no event for autonomy within a realm, so they are in the keyframe note, not the ledger. Not settled with the pages opened: the exact days of liberation (4-5 May 1945), of the 1953 Constitution (5 June 1953), of home rule (1 May 1979) and self-government (21 June 2009): all 'not on the page'; the British occupation of the Faroes (1940-45) is not on the page; Hans Island is not on the page; the monarchs of Denmark (only Frederik X, since 14 January 2024, is on the page), so identity.rulers is omitted. wars is empty: no war with a territorial result in 1945-2026 on the pages opened.

The end year 2026 is the current year (the state is alive).
